summaries.n-inference-credits: Orbio (orbio.so) sells LLM credits at a discount. Its coin ORBIO (pons) and two Flap coins, SUAN and bInference (BINF), describe turning trading fees into AI inference credits: ORBIO and SUAN say holders or stakers receive credits, BINF says its agents' fees pay for their AI use. These are project claims; payouts and usage are not verified, and no affiliation among the coins was checked. Measured: three coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-pair-rewards: StonkFun reward coins turn transfer tax into distributions of the paired asset. Measured: ZCAT (paid in ZEC), KNOTS (paid in STONK) and PUMPE (3% tax to PEPE reflections, per its metadata) across all pools; the quote assets are excluded.

n-inference-credits.notice: orbio.so: "Get LLM credits, at a discount. One key, every model, no subscriptions." Its FAQ says the discount comes "From Orbio holders who offer unused credit at a discount."
n-inference-credits.interpretation: The official page describes a discounted credit marketplace. The fee-to-credit payout to coin holders comes from token metadata and project posts (SUAN, bInference, Orbio builders), not from the page; payouts and usage are self-reported and unverified.

robinhood:0xaa07a0e9209e16ac99708c3ec701.rationale: Orbio.so ($ORBIO, pons, pool created 2026-09-20): Codex metadata says "Half of trading fees are converted into inference credits and paid to holders, in dollars"; orbio.so sells LLM credits at a discount and Orbio's own X posts describe holders being paid in inference credit. Exact chain, address and covered origin launchpad from the d1 sweep.

bsc:0xc561dc47b9c1c036e77ecffdde66b8f451.rationale: SUAN (Flap, pool created 2026-10-01): Codex metadata says half of trading fees convert to BEAD, "1 BEAD = $1 AI inference credit", credited hourly to stakers. @SUANdotBID posts repeat the formula and cite Orbio as the model. Exact chain, address and covered origin launchpad from the d1 sweep.

bsc:0x9862d6478cb8098645815ff27f91efbc65.rationale: bInference (Flap, pool created 2026-09-30): Codex metadata says "Launch an agent token and its fees pay for it's AI" and offers AI credits at a discount; @getbinference says every token its router processed is paid for by BSC fees from those agents. Exact chain, address and covered origin launchpad from the d1 sweep.

solana:9fJAWKQpkY93hfuZxrHfh5wEh2AV9vjkW.rationale: Pumpkin Pepe ($PUMPE, StonkFun, pool created 2026-10-01): Codex metadata says it is a StonkFun launch paired with bridged ETH $PEPE with a 3% transaction tax to $PEPE reflections for holders, the same paired-asset reward mechanism as ZCAT and KNOTS. k-elon.reason: Word match only: quq is a 2025 BSC emoji coin mentioning Elon in its description; e/acc and ELON (fees paid in stock) are unrelated. The e2 search surfaced only 2025 shill posts and no Elon story.

k-tokenized.reason: XDP is Doppler Finance (exchange-listed XRP/Base yield project; OKX, Gate posts); FUSE and STACK are stock-paired launch tools. No shared story or launchpad-origin theme.

k-paid.reason: ORBIO moves into the new inference-credits narrative. PAID and ELON are UsePaid or stock-fee coins already covered by other narratives or without metadata; ERRAND (paid in Orbio credit) and SHILL (hold-to-earn ETH) are separate products.

k-stocks.reason: Stock-backed launch tools (STONK quote asset, FUSE, X7, STACK) and OTC/RBD: different mechanisms, no single new story today; STONK is a quote asset.

k-layer.reason: Generic word "layer": PEXRA is a pre-launch experience-layer coin with no product source; PARLEY, WORM, FATHOM, LIEGE are unrelated RH-chain infra coins; ORBITAL is an Orbio-built audit app, not a fee-to-credit coin.

k-hold.reason: ORBIO moves to inference credits; PUMPE joins holder rewards in the paired asset (its metadata names the StonkFun paired-asset tax). GP and SEC ("hold to earn gold / XRP") lack paired-asset or tax metadata and are recorded as candidates; SHILL is a $62K-cap ETH-for-posting coin.

k-inference.reason: Fee-to-AI-inference-credit story deferred earlier today now qualifies: ORBIO, SUAN and BINF (3 coins, Flap and pons, $9.3M combined 24h), metadata names the mechanism, and orbio.so, @SUANdotBID and @getbinference are independent official sources. MANY (routing API, no fee mechanism) and CASINO excluded.

k-credits.reason: Same lead as k-inference: ORBIO, SUAN, BINF. TANK (stake for CREDIT rewards, game) and PRIORS (agent credit loans) excluded.

k-orbio.reason: ORBIO joins the new inference-credits narrative. ERRAND and ORBITAL are apps built on Orbio, not fee-to-credit coins, and have under $1M cap and no independent source.

k-market.reason: Generic word: prediction markets (SGT, RBD) mixed with LUCKY99, THESIS and ASKR; SUAN moves to inference credits. SGT posts are launch hype with no common story with RBD.

k-around.reason: Generic word: PEXRA, UDR (a "dividend for Americans" coin on a $729M implausible cap) and LIEGE share no story.

k-building.reason: Generic word: PEXRA, 4 (BNB Chain community coin) and MANY share no story.

k-stonkfun.reason: PUMPE joins holder rewards in the paired asset. COMMIE only says it launched on StonkFun and GP lacks tax or paired-asset metadata; no new story from the StonkFun word match.

k-backed.reason: SUAN and BINF move into inference credits; STONK is a quote asset.

k-credit.reason: SUAN moves into inference credits. PRIORS is agent credit loans/reputation (USDG credit for ERC-8004 agents), OTIS an agent business, ERRAND an Orbio-built board, TANK a game and CASINO a casino: "credit" is a generic word with no shared fee mechanism.

k-through.reason: Generic word: SACC (Super Accelerationism, a Super Intelligence-adjacent name but with no rename or SI mention in metadata and no source; the e2 search was refunded as a bad match), RBD, UDR and MANY share no story.
